facts.fact: UNECA (2026-03-12) quotes Director Mohamed Mashaka of the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology calling the 'government's 10-year Digital Economy Strategy Framework (2024-2034)' the alignment for the data governance strategy, so its stated period had not ended; the article does not describe the framework's scope (class left empty) or link its text. Text public: not stated

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, with UNECA, AUDA-NEPAD and GIZ
systems.tiers: national; a national validation workshop was held in Dodoma on 2026-03-12 and the Government reaffirmed its commitment to advancing it 'toward formal adoption'

note: TZeDGS (data governance) is thematic: validated at a workshop, not adopted. The Digital Economy Strategy Framework's class is empty because the article only names it as the alignment of that strategy.
